## 1. Team Overview

The migration programme requires a compact, cross-functional team of **6–7 people** operating across a 6-phase, ~28-week delivery window. The team is AI-augmented at every role: GitHub Copilot handles code drafting and agent-driven analysis; M365 Copilot handles documentation review, status summarisation, and meeting notes.

AI tools act as **accelerators and drafting engines — not decision authorities**. Every output from an AI agent is reviewed by a named human before being committed or presented to stakeholders.

---

## 2. Role Definitions

### 2.1 Executive Sponsor

| Attribute | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Responsibility** | Owns the business case; resolves escalated risks and blockers; approves phase gate sign-offs when the delivery lead escalates; champions the programme at organisational level |
| **Decision authority** | Final authority on scope changes, phase deferrals, and resource trade-offs that cannot be resolved within the team |
| **Commitment** | ~2 hours/week — phase gate reviews, escalation calls, milestone approvals |
| **AI augmentation** | M365 Copilot for summarising programme status reports and preparing executive briefings |
| **Expected productivity impact** | Neutral on velocity; critical for clearing blockers that would otherwise stall a phase |

---

### 2.2 Delivery Lead / Programme Manager

| Attribute | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Responsibility** | Day-to-day programme governance; phase gate coordination; risk tracking in `migration-run-journal.md`; stakeholder communication; scheduling and resource management |
| **Decision authority** | Approves phase entry and exit within scope; escalates to Executive Sponsor when scope, budget, or timeline is threatened |
| **Commitment** | Full-time during active phases; part-time (planning/governance only) during Phase 0 |
| **AI augmentation** | M365 Copilot for drafting status reports, meeting notes, and stakeholder communications; GitHub Copilot Chat for querying `migration-run-journal.md` open issues |
| **Expected productivity impact** | 25–30% reduction in status reporting overhead via M365 Copilot |

---

### 2.3 Cloud / Solutions Architect

| Attribute | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Responsibility** | Owns `docs/Target-Architecture.md` and all Bicep infrastructure; designs the Azure resource topology; reviews all architectural decisions in `docs/ADR/`; unblocks developers on patterns and platform constraints |
| **Decision authority** | All architectural decisions (module boundaries, dependency rules, Azure resource selection, security design); escalates to Delivery Lead for budget-impacting choices |
| **Commitment** | Full-time during Phases 0–2 and Phase 6; 50% during Phases 3–5 (review and advisory) |
| **AI augmentation** | GitHub Copilot for Bicep module generation and review; `azure-infra-planner.agent` and `azure-infra-implementer.agent` for infrastructure provisioning; App Insights alert rule generation |
| **Expected productivity impact** | 40% reduction in Bicep authoring and review time via agent-generated modules |

---

### 2.4 Senior Developer 1 — VB.NET / Domain Expert

| Attribute | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Responsibility** | Leads Phase 4 domain module conversion; primary knowledge holder for legacy VB.NET business rules; owns `HistopathologyLib` migration to C# POCO + Dapper repositories; pair-reviews all domain-layer code |
| **Decision authority** | Approves functional equivalence of converted domain logic; raises ISS-* issues in journal when legacy behaviour is ambiguous |
| **Commitment** | Full-time during Phases 1–5 |
| **AI augmentation** | GitHub Copilot for VB.NET-to-C# translation (accelerates boilerplate); `dotnet-framework-upgrade.agent` for project file and NuGet migration; `identity-migration.agent` for auth wiring |
| **Expected productivity impact** | 35–45% reduction in mechanical VB→C# translation effort; developer focuses on validating business logic rather than retyping |

---

### 2.5 Senior Developer 2 — .NET 10 / Azure Platform

| Attribute | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Responsibility** | Leads Phase 1 scaffold, Phase 2 auth, and Phase 5 UI migration; owns `Histo.Web` Razor Pages; implements `ISessionService`, `IDbConnectionFactory`, and application DI wiring; owns the CI/CD pipeline |
| **Decision authority** | All Razor Pages routing and layout decisions; GitHub Actions pipeline structure |
| **Commitment** | Full-time during Phases 1–6 |
| **AI augmentation** | GitHub Copilot for Razor Pages scaffolding, HTMX integration patterns, and test generation; `devops-pipeline-modernizer.agent` for CI/CD pipeline YAML |
| **Expected productivity impact** | 30–40% reduction in Razor Pages boilerplate; HTMX pattern code generated by Copilot and reviewed by developer |

---

### 2.6 QA Engineer

| Attribute | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Responsibility** | Owns `tests/Histo.Tests/` and the Playwright E2E suite; validates functional equivalence at each phase gate; creates and maintains test data profiles for Crystal Reports reference baseline; performs exploratory testing on converted pages before phase sign-off |
| **Decision authority** | Test pass/fail gates; flags test failures as blockers for phase exit; accepts risk when a known limitation is documented and deferred |
| **Commitment** | Full-time during Phases 3, 5, and 6; 50% during Phases 0–2 and Phase 4 |
| **AI augmentation** | `testing.agent` for baseline unit test generation; `e2e-baseline-orchestrator.agent` for Playwright E2E baseline; GitHub Copilot for parametrised test generation and assertion helpers |
| **Expected productivity impact** | 50% reduction in baseline test authoring time; E2E selector registry and page objects generated by agent, reviewed and adjusted by QA engineer |

---

### 2.7 DevOps Engineer (Part-Time or Shared Resource)

| Attribute | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Responsibility** | Provisions Azure environments (dev, test, UAT, prod) from Bicep templates; configures GitHub Actions environments and protection rules; populates Key Vault secrets; executes managed identity SQL grant post-deployment; configures Application Insights alerts |
| **Decision authority** | Infrastructure provisioning decisions within the approved Bicep plan; escalates to Architect for any deviation |
| **Commitment** | 50% during Phase 6; 25% during Phases 1 and 2 (dev environment setup) |
| **AI augmentation** | `azure-infra-implementer.agent` for Bicep module generation; GitHub Copilot for pipeline YAML and deployment script authoring |
| **Expected productivity impact** | 40% reduction in Bicep authoring and Azure CLI script time |

## 3. RACI Summary

| Activity | Exec Sponsor | Delivery Lead | Architect | Sr Dev 1 | Sr Dev 2 | QA | DevOps |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Phase gate approval | **A** | R | C | I | I | I | I |
| Architecture decisions | I | I | **A/R** | C | C | I | C |
| Domain logic conversion | I | I | C | **A/R** | C | C | I |
| UI / Razor Pages conversion | I | I | C | C | **A/R** | C | I |
| Test strategy and execution | I | I | I | C | C | **A/R** | I |
| Azure infra provisioning | I | I | **A** | I | I | I | R |
| CI/CD pipeline | I | C | C | I | **A/R** | C | C |
| Risk and issue tracking | I | **A/R** | C | C | C | C | C |
| Stakeholder communication | **A** | R | I | I | I | I | I |

*A = Accountable, R = Responsible, C = Consulted, I = Informed*

## 4. AI Tool Augmentation by Phase

| Phase | GitHub Copilot Agents Used | M365 Copilot Use | Human Review Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `documentation.agent`, `testing.agent`, `pdf-reference-generator.agent` | Summarise HLD/LLD for exec review | Architect reviews all generated docs; QA reviews test suite |
| 1 | `dotnet-framework-upgrade.agent` (project migration) | — | Architect reviews solution structure; Sr Dev 2 reviews scaffold |
| 2 | `identity-migration.agent` | Summarise auth design for stakeholders | Architect reviews auth wiring; Sr Dev 1 validates claims mapping |
| 3 | `pdf-migration-orchestrator.agent` pipeline | — | QA validates RMSE diffs; Sr Dev 1 reviews ViewModel design |
| 4 | `dotnet-code-refactor.agent` per module | — | Sr Dev 1 validates every domain logic translation |
| 5 | `ui-implementation.agent` per batch | — | QA validates Playwright E2E; end-user UAT sign-off per batch |
| 6 | `azure-infra-planner.agent`, `azure-infra-implementer.agent`, `devops-pipeline-modernizer.agent` | Prepare cutover communications | Architect reviews Bicep what-if before production deployment |

## 5. Escalation Paths

```
Issue detected
      │
      ▼
Developer / QA raises ISS-* in migration-run-journal.md
      │
      ▼
Delivery Lead reviews within 1 business day
      │
      ├── Resolvable within phase scope? → Developer resolves → ISS closed
      │
      └── Requires architecture change, scope change, or budget impact?
              │
              ▼
          Delivery Lead escalates to Architect + Executive Sponsor
              │
              ▼
          Decision documented in Decision Log (migration-run-journal.md)
              │
              ▼
          Phase gate delayed or adjusted — timeline updated in this document
```

## 6. Team Capacity and Onboarding

### Onboarding checklist for each team member

- [ ] Read `docs/HLD.md` and `docs/LLD.md` — understand the current system
- [ ] Read `docs/Migration-Plan.md` — understand phase scope and rollback
- [ ] Read `docs/Target-Architecture.md` — understand the target structure
- [ ] Read `docs/Test-Strategy.md` — understand the test approach
- [ ] Run `dotnet test tests/Histo.Tests/` — confirm local setup is working
- [ ] Review open issues in `migration-run-journal.md`
- [ ] Confirm GitHub Copilot is active in VS Code (organisation licence)

### Knowledge transfer risk

Senior Developer 1 holds the primary institutional knowledge of the VB.NET business rules. This is a key-person risk. Mitigations:

1. All business rules are documented in `docs/LLD.md` and `docs/ADR/` before Sr Dev 1 begins conversion.
2. All converted business logic is covered by named unit tests in `Histo.Tests/`.
3. Sr Dev 1 pair-reviews Sr Dev 2's work on any domain-adjacent UI conversion.
